text_en: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the exiles by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
text_cn: 三十年四月五日，当我在革巴尔河畔，在俘虏之中的时候，天开了，我见了天主的异像，

text_en: On the fifth day of the month (it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin),
text_cn: 时在耶苛尼雅王充军后第五年四月五日；

text_en: the word of the Lord came to the priest Ezekiel son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was on him there.
text_cn: 那时在加色丁地，靠近革巴尔河，上主的话传给步齐的儿子厄则克耳司祭，上主的手临于我。

text_en: As I looked, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud with brightness around it and fire flashing forth continually, and in the middle of the fire, something like gleaming amber.
text_cn: 我观望，看，有一阵暴风由北方吹来，刮来一大块火光四射的云彩，云中有一团旋转的火，火中有一种发亮的金属。

text_en: In the middle of it was something like four living creatures. This was their appearance: they were of human form.
text_cn: 火中似乎有四个活物的形状，它们的外表是这样：都有人的形状。

text_en: Each had four faces, and each of them had four wings.
text_cn: 每个有四种形像，每个有四只翅膀。

text_en: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
text_cn: 它们的脚是直立的脚，脚掌像牛蹄，发亮像磨光的铜。

text_en: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. And the four had their faces and their wings thus:
text_cn: 在它们四面的翅膀下边，都有人手；四个活物各有自己的形像和翅膀。

text_en: their wings touched one another; each of them moved straight ahead, without turning as they moved.
text_cn: 它们的翅膀互相连接，在行走时不必转身，各朝着自己的前面行走。

text_en: As for the appearance of their faces: the four had the face of a human being, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and the face of an eagle;
text_cn: 关于它们外表的形像：它们四个的正面都具有人的形像，右边有狮的形像，左边有牛的形像，背面有鹰的形像。

text_en: such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above; each creature had two wings, each of which touched the wing of another, while two covered their bodies.
text_cn: 它们的翅膀向上伸开，每个用两只翅膀互相连接，用两只翅膀遮蔽身体。

text_en: Each moved straight ahead; wherever the spirit would go, they went, without turning as they went.
text_cn: 每个朝着自己的前面行走；神力催迫它们往哪里去，它们就往那里去；行走时不必转身。

text_en: In the middle of the living creatures there was something that looked like burning coals of fire, like torches moving to and fro among the living creatures; the fire was bright, and lightning issued from the fire.
text_cn: 在活物中间有一种相似燃着的炭火，又好似火炬在活物中旋转。这火有亮光，由火中射出闪光。

text_en: The living creatures darted to and fro, like a flash of lightning.
text_cn: 活物来回疾驰，好像闪电。

text_en: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, one for each of the four of them.
text_cn: 我观望那些活物时，看，靠近那些活物的四面，在地上各有一个轮子。

text_en: As for the appearance of the wheels and their construction: their appearance was like the gleaming of beryl; and the four had the same form, their construction being something like a wheel within a wheel.
text_cn: 那些轮子及其构造的外表，光泽有如橄榄石，四轮都有同样的形状。四轮结构的样式，好像轮子套在轮子中。

text_en: When they moved, they moved in any of the four directions without veering as they moved.
text_cn: 轮子转动时，可向四方旋转，前行时不必转辙。

text_en: Their rims were tall and awesome, for the rims of all four were full of eyes all around.
text_cn: 轮辋（wǎng）高大，我看见四个轮辋(wǎng)都布满了眼睛。

text_en: When the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them; and when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.
text_cn: 活物行走时，轮子也在它们旁边转动；活物由地面升起时，轮子也升起。

text_en: Wherever the spirit would go, they went, and the wheels rose along with them; for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
text_cn: 神力催迫活物往那里去，它们就往神力催迫的方向去；轮子也同时与它们一起升起因为活物的神力在轮子内。

text_en: When they moved, the others moved; when they stopped, the others stopped; and when they rose from the earth, the wheels rose along with them; for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
text_cn: 活物行走，轮子也转动；活物站住，轮子也停住；活物由地上升起，轮子也随之升起，因为活物的神力在轮子内。

text_en: Over the heads of the living creatures there was something like a dome, shining like crystal, spread out above their heads.
text_cn: 在活物的头上，有相似穹苍的东西，好像发亮的水晶，在它们头上展开。

text_en: Under the dome their wings were stretched out straight, one toward another; and each of the creatures had two wings covering its body.
text_cn: 在穹苍下伸直它们的翅膀，一只的翅膀与另一只的翅膀彼此相接，又各有两只翅膀遮蔽着身体。

text_en: When they moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of mighty waters, like the thunder of the Almighty, a sound of tumult like the sound of an army; when they stopped, they let down their wings.
text_cn: 当它们行动时，我听见翅膀的飒飒声，像洪水之声，又像全能者的声音，又似军营中的喧噪之声。当它们站住时，就敛起翅膀。

text_en: And there came a voice from above the dome over their heads; when they stopped, they let down their wings.
text_cn: 那时，由它们头顶上的穹苍那里，发出一种响声；活物即站住，就敛起翅膀。

text_en: And above the dome over their heads there was something like a throne, in appearance like sapphire; and seated above the likeness of a throne was something that seemed like a human form.
text_cn: 在她们头顶上的穹苍上面，有一块像蓝玉的石头，有宝座的形状；在这状如宝座之上，有一个外貌像人的坐在上头。

text_en: Upward from what appeared like the loins I saw something like gleaming amber, something that looked like fire enclosed all around; and downward from what looked like the loins I saw something that looked like fire, and there was a splendor all around.
text_cn: 我望见在他相似腰部的上面，好像有发亮的金属，内里和周围好像一团火。我又望见在相似腰部的下面，好像有火的形状，周围有光环绕，

text_en: Like the bow in a cloud on a rainy day, such was the appearance of the splendor all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of someone speaking.
text_cn: 环绕在周围的光，犹如落雨时云彩中所出现的虹霓。这就是上主的光荣显现时的奇象。我一看见，就伏地掩面，同时也听见有一位讲话的声音。
